title: Afterglow Notes
bio: Recording, digging into and extending whatever I run across, notice or think about.
repoNote: Only repos that are still moving. Status comes from the last commit — keeping dead things listed is just debt.
finePrintBlurb: No tracking, no ads, and no selling your data to anyone.
finePrintPoints: Read counts are anonymous totals only — no referrers
Comments happen over email; nothing extra is stored about you
Fonts and images are all self-hosted
finePrintReply: I usually reply within three days. Long letters take a little longer.
